# Autogenerated playlists

These lists are built by GitHub Actions and are not edited manually.

- all.m3u: all public channels, Tamil first, with authorized on-demand films if configured.
- tamil.m3u: Tamil TV plus authorized Tamil on-demand entries.
- tamil-movies.m3u: Tamil movie TV channels, not a film library.
- movies.m3u: worldwide movie TV channels.
- tamil-movies-on-demand.m3u: only authorized direct movie videos supplied by the maintainer.
- status.json: last update time and counts.

The files above appear after the first successful workflow run.
